purpose: Deterministic smoke journey set for the container-first ui-journeys CI lane. Used verbatim on ordinary PRs to `testing` (D.4) and as the base of the `full` proven set elsewhere. Every id must exist in tests/simulation/lib/scenario-registry.mjs — scripts/check_required_checks.py-independent validation runs in the lane's resolve step and fails closed on unknown ids.
selection_rule: Only journeys that are (a) credential-free, (b) compatible with the qa-provider-stub contract lane (no live model completions), and (c) proven green on the QA stack may be listed here. W5 (browser-spine-acceptance) grows this list with execution evidence.
